pin_regs.reason: The RTL registers every input at its pin (rn, cs_q, lay_q, tag_q, gen_q) and every output is a flop (compiled_identity / compiled_generation); the fixed latencies (cohort 2, cal_start 3 edges) are the ones tools/qwen_kv_die/kvn_ctx_golden.py checks against the link compiler's KVN windows (>= 645 edges margin). A flow-inserted second stage is not needed.

job.purpose: Q-KVSYS PVJOIN 10-16: KV-side compiled KVN context = the independent expectation kvn_compiled_identity[58:0] / kvn_compiled_generation[1:0] of qkd_d2d_static (2 of the 17 strict-bind open inputs, bind17_producers.json). identity = {HOST cohort epoch16, stage = KV link calendar run index + 1, cohort token18/position13, 0}, generation = HOST cohort_gen; sources the HOST root cohort_tag/cohort_gen and the KV link calendar sequencer qkd_d2d_cal_seq_pin cal_start/layer. Fixed latency, no credits/ready. Bench: real sequencer image + real KVN tx/rx, 2 tokens x 36 runs x 4 words exact vs the link compiler's program calendar; mutants stage-off-by-one and cohort-snapshot FAIL.
